query: How smoothly does the Motorola Moto G Power (2022) run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?
search_text: How smoothly does the ) run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?

rows.text: Very Slow, All Apps Lag. I was really shocked at how slow the apps run on this phone. I use it primarily as a driver for Doordash. After 3 months the lag just got worse and worse. After pressing the shutter on the camera there was a 7 or 8 second lag before it would take the photo. Apps keep crashing. I reset to factory settings and performance improved for a couple of weeks, and now it is worse than before. Very disappointed!
I liked it until I didn't. Started to lag and freeze. I returned it.

All out decent. Pros: Good battery life, smoothness, video quality, and pictures Cons: Every phone comes with a weird unique bug, ya never know what your going to get. Mine randomly disconnects from the wifi. My last moto would exit out of apps that are running in the background. This sucked especially because of Spotify and games. But this one's bugs are not as bad
Room for improvement. Phones freezes and slows down if you try to switch from vertical to horizontal fast or when exiting an app fast

Good phone but. This is a good phone but it is slow. The phone lags a lot from switching app to just using an app, the processor lags all over even going through the settings. This processor that they use for this is underpowered for what a smartphones does in the modern day (2022) . But at the end of the day it does what it needs to do everything works fine when it is working and it is running . The camera lags a little bit when taking pictures so if you have shaky hands look elsewhere, signal strength and Bluetooth are really good I have no issues. Especially the fingerprint, I love the location of the fingerprint and it works wonderful.
SLOW. This thing is worse than my cheap Revlry was. Constantly lags and freezes.

I have several apps and still have only used about 40% of the storage, although, the only social media app that I have is Messenger. (They are storage suckers) Chrome and the apps that I have work pretty quickly and I do not notice much lag. So, I would recommend this phone for people that need a phone to do what it needs to do, not sure about for people that use it like a tv or gaming system. It works great for me and I am very happy with it. Oh, and I use a network that uses TMobile and as soon as I put my sim card in it connected to my network with no issues.

Good Features, but slow. It is a nice phone with great features. However, I mainly use it for the internet and I swap between apps frequently and quickly. The phone is not able to keep up with what I am trying to accomplish. Aside from being noticeably slow and freezing, the phone is decent for the price.

Slow, clunky phone that freezes up often. I've owned previous models of the moto g and have been satisfied with them. For whatever reason, this version is AWFUL. I bought and returned this model and got replacement thinking there were issues with my first phone. Apparently not. The phone constantly freezes. Apps freeze and stop working. The camera is terrible and slow and also will freeze up. So it's great for those special moments you don't want to capture. Sometime my phone will be stuck for hours for what I presume is an system update? No idea. These are cheap phone overall, but always worked well for me in the past. I have issues with this phone daily and this will be my last moto g product.
Terrible. I usually never leave reviews, but this phone is the worst phone I've ever had. Very slow apps are always freezing. I had the Moto G7 power which was way better, as well as the Samsung a21

This phone freezes and lags constantly. If you like voice to text don't buy this phone it's the worst voice to text phone I've ever used. Phone is constantly freezing and lagging I can't believe it has 8 GB of RAM. I want to like this phone but it's been a miserable experience. I used GPS a lot and rely on the voice to text feature so I can't recommend this phone at all

Tiny bit of lag. The phone does everything I love. The side finger-print reader in the power button is great. Shake on/off flashlight working like a champ. There's some rare lag, but, for a $200 phone, I'll take it!

In some games I get those stutters. As a gaming device I wouldn't recommend it atleast if you play shooters and racing games. Multi tasking will slow it down and cause glitches and freezing after awhile maybe not right after you get the phone, I'd say after 9 months or so. Depends on how you use it I guess. All in all. Its ok. Battery Lasts for days easily but it's missing great features and the speed and power a lot of newer phones have. As a backup phone I say yes, just for calls and some app usage and light gaming.

There's also a considerable delay when you're switching from picture to video. If you want to catch your kid or pet doing something cute, you won't be able to with this phone. The moment will have passed by the time the camera does its thing. I've had $50 phones work better than this, to be honest. Oh also apps often freeze up and then I get the pop up that lets me wait or shut it down. It happens at least once a day. Edit: so I guess this phone slows down over time. It's even worse now. Apps freeze up several times a day. I think the camera has gotten even slower. I'm going to buy a different one.

Right out of the box the phone would hang for up to 5 seconds. Apps load incredibly slow, it regularly lags while typing, and the battery life is about 50% worse than the previous model even though they are the same size! This phone really makes everything a chore. Anytime I need it to perform it lags uncontrollably for what feels like ages. At first I thought maybe there was an issue when I was transferring my apps so I went through the process of factory restoring it and manually re-adding all my apps and data. This helped nothing and honestly it feels worse than before the reset. Now I'm at a point where I'm looking to either buy a new phone or just go back to using my old one.

Do not do it. So much bloatware you cannot download more than 5 or 6 app before running out of space. Definitely not recommend. You can buy a better phone for the same money with more ram and better response.

Very slow. This phone blends in with the crowd, but the processor lagged from out of the box, day one. Takes a split second for the scroll to start under your finger, then the scroll is choppy. Everything is very noticeably slower than it should be . Basically, if this is what you can afford, it is functional, but don't fall under the delusion that it is a good phone. I have one as a backup, but I would rather throw it against a wall.

Don't bother unfortunately. I hate to say it but my Motorola Play that I purchased in early 2020 was way more smooth than this "Power" phone upgrade. It lags considerably and it's 3 day purported battery life is false advertising, I'm lucky to get through a full day with heavy use. The only pros are the nice screen size for me anyway and hey it doesn't over heat... much. Skip it.

Mediocre. I've been using Moto G phones for years because they're affordable and the camera quality has been decent. I was hoping that with current technology, the camera would be great. It's... Okay. The quality is just okay. But what's most frustrating is the camera app itself has a HUGE lag in processing time, so I'm constantly missing good shots and I'm left with a blur because of a 10+ second delay in the photo being taken! It takes forever to exit/close the camera app as well. Motorola is useless in response to reviews on the camera app, too, just asking for screenshots of the issue. HOW? I also have lots of issues with the screen responding to touch if I'm not holding it normally. For example, if I have the phone laying on a table and I'm trying to tap or type, it just won't work.

Cheap budget phone with a long lasting battery, but freezes up all the time. I bought this phone because my phone went out and I couldn't afford to get a more expensive one. I bought this in 2021 and I still have it. The battery life is great. I really didn't like the interface of the ios compared to the Galaxy I previously had. This didn't start happening immediately, but now it's getting worse. The phone will completely freeze up and go black screen and I have to do a hard reset by holding the lock button and the volume down button until it forces itself to restart. I try to open Chase bank app, it freezes. I'm in the middle of a trip on google maps, it freezes. I just tried to call my mom and it froze.
